achievements.name: The Streets
achievements.detail: Clear the opening stage, The Streets.

achievements.name: The Commissioner
achievements.detail: Fight through the Police Precinct and defeat the Commissioner.

achievements.name: Second Wind
achievements.detail: Spend health on a special move, then earn that recoverable life back by landing hits.

achievements.name: Star Special
achievements.detail: Spend a collected star to unleash a character's star special in a fight.

achievements.name: S Rank
achievements.detail: Finish any stage with a score that earns an S rank.

achievements.name: Story Clear
achievements.detail: Beat Story mode from the first stage through the last on any difficulty.

achievements.name: Arcade Clear
achievements.detail: Clear Arcade mode in a single run before your lives run out.

achievements.name: Boss Rush
achievements.detail: Defeat the full line of bosses in Boss Rush without losing your only life.

achievements.name: Battle Winner
achievements.detail: Win a match in Battle mode.

achievements.name: Mania Plus
achievements.detail: Finish a complete Story mode run on Mania+.
